title: Smile when greeting others
explanation: The Prophet ﷺ said that smiling at your brother is charity.
practice_tip: Greet one person today with a warm, genuine smile.

title: Say Bismillah before eating
explanation: Beginning meals with Allah's name brings blessing to the food.
practice_tip: Pause before your next meal and say Bismillah mindfully.

title: Use the right hand for eating
explanation: The Sunnah encourages eating and drinking with the right hand.
practice_tip: Be conscious of which hand you use at your next meal.

title: Remove harm from the path
explanation: Removing something harmful from the road is an act of faith.
practice_tip: If you see litter or an obstacle, safely clear it if you can.

title: Visit the sick
explanation: Visiting those who are ill is a beloved act of worship.
practice_tip: Send a kind message or call someone who is unwell.

title: Speak good or remain silent
explanation: Guarding the tongue protects the heart and relationships.
practice_tip: Before speaking today, ask if your words are kind and true.

title: Pray two rak'ah of Duha
explanation: The forenoon prayer is a gift of spiritual nourishment.
practice_tip: Try praying Duha after sunrise when your schedule allows.

title: Give charity secretly
explanation: Hidden charity preserves sincerity and multiplies reward.
practice_tip: Give a small amount today without telling anyone.

title: Make dua for someone in their absence
explanation: The angel says 'and for you the same' when you pray for others.
practice_tip: Silently ask Allah to bless someone you care about.

title: Enter the home with Salam
explanation: Greeting with peace brings barakah to the household.
practice_tip: Say Assalamu alaikum when entering your home today.

title: Sleep with wudu
explanation: Sleeping in a state of purity is a gentle Sunnah.
practice_tip: Perform wudu before bed tonight, even if briefly.

title: Recite Ayat al-Kursi after prayer
explanation: It is a means of protection until the next prayer.
practice_tip: Add Ayat al-Kursi after one of your prayers today.

title: Eat with moderation
explanation: The believer fills one third with food, one third with drink, one third with air.
practice_tip: Stop eating when you feel satisfied, not full.

title: Forgive someone today
explanation: Forgiveness lightens the heart and pleases Allah.
practice_tip: Release a small grudge you've been holding.

title: Help a neighbor
explanation: Good treatment of neighbors is part of faith.
practice_tip: Offer a small act of kindness to a neighbor.

title: Say SubhanAllah 33 times after salah
explanation: The dhikr after prayer brings immense reward.
practice_tip: Complete the post-prayer adhkar after one salah today.

title: Wear fragrance for Jumu'ah
explanation: Cleanliness and pleasant scent are encouraged for Friday.
practice_tip: Use a pleasant scent if attending Jumu'ah this week.

title: Read one page of Quran
explanation: Even a small portion daily nurtures the soul.
practice_tip: Open the Quran and read at least one page with focus.

title: Thank Allah after eating
explanation: Saying Alhamdulillah completes the blessing of food.
practice_tip: Say Alhamdulillah after finishing a meal today.

title: Lower your gaze with adab
explanation: Guarding the eyes protects purity of heart.
practice_tip: Be mindful of what you look at on screens today.

title: Shake hands warmly
explanation: A sincere handshake spreads love between believers.
practice_tip: Greet a friend or family member with warmth.

title: Pray Sunnah before Fajr
explanation: The two rak'ah before Fajr are better than the world and all it contains.
practice_tip: Wake a few minutes early to pray the Sunnah of Fajr.

title: Feed the hungry
explanation: Feeding others is among the best of deeds.
practice_tip: Share food or support a meal for someone in need.

title: Say Alhamdulillah in hardship
explanation: Gratitude in difficulty is a sign of strong faith.
practice_tip: When something is hard today, say Alhamdulillah once.

title: Maintain family ties
explanation: Keeping kinship brings blessings and lengthens life.
practice_tip: Reach out to a relative you haven't spoken to recently.

title: Sit when drinking water
explanation: The Sunnah encourages sitting while drinking.
practice_tip: Sit down for your next glass of water.

title: Pray Witr before sleep
explanation: Witr is the closing prayer of the night.
practice_tip: Don't miss Witr tonight if you haven't prayed it yet.

title: Be gentle with children
explanation: The Prophet ﷺ was known for his kindness to young ones.
practice_tip: Show extra patience and warmth to a child today.

title: Avoid anger
explanation: Strength is in controlling oneself when angry.
practice_tip: If anger rises, pause and say A'udhu billahi.

title: Reflect before sleep
explanation: A moment of reflection closes the day with mindfulness.
practice_tip: Think of one blessing from today before sleeping.
